utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, I heard there's a repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's a community event where folks bring broken items and we fix 'em together. This Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds neat! Do I need to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're collecting old appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Tess! Just a heads-up though, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! I had Saturday marked down, but I'll be there Sunday with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The repair drive is next Saturday, right? I think I can help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, let me see what we have in storage for the drive. I think we've got some spare nuts and bolts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I'll bring my toolbox too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, has anyone actually confirmed bringing tools? I don't want to show up empty-handed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard Vik is bringing his toolbox and some spare screws, so we should be covered!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Vik's on it? Good. But are we still on for the fence first, or is that later?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Dane, do you have a cost estimate for the repair drive? I'm trying to figure out what we're in for.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm not sure about costs yet—I think Quinn has the details. Want me to check with them?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 am to fix the playground swings and slide. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I remember now—I have a rusty saw that needs fixing. Are you bringing something?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll be bringing some basic tools—hammers, wrenches, that sort of thing. What's wrong with your saw?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, what's the timeline for this repair drive? I need to know when to expect things.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Timeline? Uh, not sure, I think they're still figuring it out. Check with Ira maybe?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Still no timeline? That's not good enough. Can you ask Ira for a firm date and time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Ira, do you know what items people are bringing to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I know Bo is bringing his tools, not sure about everyone else though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo's tools are a good start. Did anyone mention a toaster or anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo, do you know where and when the repair drive is happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday 10am at the community center. Bring what's broken.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll be there. Should I bring any tools or just the broken items?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll check the sign-up sheet before bringing anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, the sheet is ready! I've got it posted on the community board.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll go check it now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Vik! The more the merrier. I'll be there with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, can't wait to fix that toaster up with your help!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that. What's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we sure this repair drive is still on? I heard it got postponed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Postponed? I thought we were just talking about sorting tools first. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I heard it might be postponed—anyone confirm that? I've got the supplies list ready just in case.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Haven't heard about a postponement, but I can check with Quinn if you want.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that'd be great. I'm hoping it's still on; I've got everything sorted already.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No problem, Bo. I'll let you know what they say at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Jules. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Happy to help out. I'll check with everyone and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might be able to help a bit, but I have some things to take care of.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's great, Uli! Just so you know, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, so hopefully that works with your schedule. Let me know if you need any details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday might be better for me, actually. I'll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, take your time! Let me know what you find—we've got some basic tools here too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll grab the sign-up sheet from my house and bring it to the setup. I'll also ask around about the blender model.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds perfect, Quinn! See you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure, you can bring your lamp, Nell, but we really need to sort out who's bringing the tools first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we have a list of who's bringing tools yet? I can help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No list yet, Hana. I'd appreciate your help sorting that out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Ira! Have you heard about the repair drive happening in the neighborhood? I just learned about it from Leo.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Opal told me about it! I'm going to let Bo know he can bring his tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great! I'm glad more people are getting involved. Do you know if anyone can fix lamps? I have one that's been flickering.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive. I still can't quite remember what it's for. Can you remind me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's a repair drive! Folks bring in their broken appliances and electronics, and volunteers fix them up. Although, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday at the community center? Oh dear, I had it in my head it was Saturday. Good thing you told me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, are you free this Saturday to help out at the tool repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm free. See you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, see you Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Opal, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm planning to! But do we have a finalized location and time? I want to make sure I show up at the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think it's at the community center, but I'm not sure about the time. I just know I'm bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, are you in for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we sure this repair drive is still on? I heard it got postponed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Really? I haven't heard that—I've got it marked on my calendar. Let me check with Faye.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, what's the schedule for the repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Far as I know, it's Saturday at 10. Leo told me that, so I'm sticking with it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hmm, I'd feel better if I heard it directly from Quinn or saw it in writing.
